lines: Yaemon
Come on, come on!! I'll take good care of you, Oni-girl!
The horde of Yaemon puppets sprang up from the ground in succession and came after us.
I had thought that Kirara-senpai, who had sustained serious injuries, would be in a desperate situation, butー
Kirara
Hmph!! Small fries like you are a million years too early to beat me!
Kirara
ーSuper Freeze!!
With a piercing voice, she raised her leg overhead.
And then it was rapidly charged with cold airー
Yaemon
A Jutsu controlling cold air!? It's certainly powerful, but how will you deal with these numbers?
Kirara
Ahaha, you dummy♪ This is not a Ninja Art!!
Kirara
It's not a Ninja Art... It's the power of the Oni that I inherited from my mom! The power of the Kijin of Frost!!
Yaemon
What!!? K-Kijin!?
Yaemon looked on in amazement, and right in front of him, Kirara-senpai swung down her leg that had been charged up with cold air.
Yaemon
Hrrrm!? Th-This isー!!?
*Shiiiing!!*
A giant ice pillar emerged from the ground she had stomped onー!!
It swallowed the incoming horde of Yaemons and froze them in an instant.
Kirara
Well then, are you ready, you dirty old man? I will make you pay a hundredfold for what you did to meーand to him!!
Yaemon
Eeeeek!? W-Wait!! I got it, Oni-girl, I'll withdraw, soー
Frozen and unable to move, Yaemon panicked and grimaced.
Kirara-senpai threw him an icy cold smile and...
Kirara
ーSpecial Attack: Go With the Floe!!!
Yaemon
Eeeeeeeeeek!!
She charged both her arms with cold air and rushed forwardー
She crushed all the encased Yaemons, together with the ice she had created, in one fell swoop.
Me
Me
(A-Amazing...!!)
And I was watching the whole thing in awe.
My arms were badly injured and I couldn't move even if I wanted to...
Well, she probably didn't need my help anyways.
That was Kirara-senpai's "true" powerー
Me
(She did say something about the Kijin of Frost...)
The power to control cold air that Kirara-senpai had inherited from her mother.
I had read about the Kijin of Frost in some ancient book before.
If I remembered correctly... they were a mythical race of Oni that were said to freeze all life and bring about the Dark Night.
If Kirara-senpai was descended from them, then her overwhelming strength was understandable.
Kirara
Hnngh... I was gonna give that dirty old man a good beating, but his ability to run away, at the very least, is top-notch...!
Seemingly frustrated, Kirara-senpai looked at the ground littered with shattered ice.
It appeared that Yaemon had barely escaped the wrathful daughter of a Kijin with his life.
Me
...Thank you very much, senpai. I was talking all high and mighty... and you ended up saving me.
I managed to somehow get up from the ground and called out to Kirara-senpai.
As was always the case, my lack of power was utterly pathetic.
Kirara
Eh!? Ah... yeah... Fuma... kun...?
Kirara-senpai jumped up nimbly and turned to face me.
Me
Are you okay? You fought so hard even with such a bad injuryー
Kirara
I-It was nothing! ...Well, it still hurts a little, but I have the blood of my invincible mom in my veins!
Me
Haha, you're incredible.
Seriously, hats off to her.
With such a strong-willed and awesome senpai, I couldn't complain no matter how much she made fun of me.
Kirara
...But wait!? What about your own injuries!?
Kirara
Your arm was, like, mangledー Doesn't it hurt!? Are you okay!?
Me
Eh? Y-Yeah...?
Kirara-senpai rushed over to me quickly and grabbed my injured arm.
...Hmm? What was going on?
The atmosphere was totally different from when we had been running through the subway tunnel.
Was Kirara-senpai terribly worried about me for real...?
Kirara
Wh-What's going on!? Your arm... i-it's healed...?
Me
Ah, it started, huh.
It was the aforementioned mysterious regenerative power.
According to the demonologist Kiryu-sensei, it was the "power of demons" that had been dormant inside meー
My arm, which had been broken and twisted, was slowly starting to heal little by little.
Kirara
A-A Ninja Art of healing...? But I heard that you didn't have the ability to use a Ninja Art...
Me
Well, it's a long story, but I recently became able to use one.
Kirara
H-Huh? Recently...
To be precise, it apparently wasn't a Ninja Art, but there was no need to explain that much.
For starters, I didn't really understand much about it myself.
Me
(This power is still full of mysteries...)
Was there a limit to the regeneration? And what would happen if I kept using it? ーIt was all a mystery.
It was quite possible that the regeneration would suddenly stop working at some point.
With that in mind, I didn't want to rely on this ability just yet.
Kirara
I-I see... But being able to regenerate must be really useful!
Kirara
With this it would be easy for you to protect me... Because you would heal anyways!!
Me
Well, I guess.
I gave her a wry smile and nodded.
I felt relieved. Kirara-senpai seemed to be back to her usual self.
Kirara
Kirara
Thank you, Fuma... For protecting me...
Turning away, Kirara-senpai spoke quietly, almost whispering.
Me
No problem. It was only natural. We're members of the same team after all.
Me
If it's within my power, I'll do anything.
Kirara
Me
Senpai?
I wondered what was wrong.
Looking away, Kirara-senpai's face had suddenly turned bright red.
Me
I'm sorry. Did I say something to offend you again?
Kirara
Huuuuuuh～!!? A-Are you stupid!? I'm not angry at all!
Me
Okay...
That was good to hear.
Kirara
You did nothing wrong at all!! I'm the one who's to blame!!
Kirara
I'm sorry, Fuma!! I said nothing but horrible things to you! I'm really sorry about that!!
Me
You realized now!? No, I mean, I returned fire too...
Kirara
Th-That's right!! Well then, with that being thatー
Kirara
Come on, let's hurry up and find Hebiko-chan and Shikanosuke-kun!! We're off!!
Me
Yeah...
I didn't really understand.
Still not facing me, Kirara-senpai rattled on and on. Then she went ahead of me and briskly walked off.
